dailyBrief.text: Overnight: the White House waived Russia energy sanctions in a surprise move, and Pope Leo XIV is back on duty after lung tumor surgery. Markets open the week rattled — a tech selloff tied to AI spending jitters — while SpaceX's Cargo Dragon is on its way to the space station. Closer to home, rain and cold postponed Game 4 of the ALCS in Cleveland, so the Guardians wait; the Browns host Baltimore at 1 PM today. Solon woke up to frost, but it's a sunny, dry day ahead — good football weather.

weekBrief.text: Fall is in full swing in Solon: after this morning's frost, a sunny, dry stretch with highs in the mid-60s — a good week to get outside before the cold sticks around. The Browns host Baltimore today, the Cavs open at home Saturday night, and the Guardians' playoff run is on a weather pause. Grocery play of the week: Giant Eagle's free-turkey deal (spend $350 by Nov 8) stacks nicely with Meijer's $1.99/lb pork shoulder for easy dinners. Around town: pumpkin voting at the library, trunk-or-treat Thursday in Solon, and Heinen's clam bake Friday in Chagrin Falls. And the baby countdown is officially on — the checklist is loaded and ready to start checking off.
